reproducedFailureBeforePatch.scenario: Another checklist item links the selected CaseDocument after the editor dropdown was loaded

fileRelationAudit.rootCause: The failed explicit file operation could be hidden by Save: an otherwise clean autosave flush succeeded and closed the editor, despite the file link not having persisted. The successful HTTP 200 relation and rendering path was already correct.
fileRelationAudit.qualification: Confirmed by a controlled before/after reproduction. The original Production incident request was not traced during this isolated task.
fileRelationAudit.afterPatch: Save remains disabled while the explicit operation has an unresolved error. Retry retains the selected file and acknowledges the returned item/version. Link, Save, reload, reopen and unlink pass; physical file and CaseDocument remain intact.
fileRelationAudit.architecture: Existing CaseDocument.checklistItemId relation and existing authenticated file endpoint; no storage/provider change

oldMosAudit.dateSemantics: Separate editable submission date picker. Initialize only an empty picker from form.mosSentAt when set and not after UTC today; otherwise UTC today. Explicit picker value wins; future dates are disallowed.
oldMosAudit.oldWrite: Legacy MOS Tasks marked done with mosDocument.sentAt equal to the chosen date
oldMosAudit.oldSuccess: Reload both MOS lists and clear selection
oldMosAudit.restoredV2: Separate real selection checkboxes; Select all and Shift range; same date semantics; atomic updates of the same CaseChecklistItem IDs to SUBMITTED_TO_MOS with mosSubmittedAt. Full acknowledged checklist payload updates groups/counts without document navigation. Notes, files and existing receivedAt remain intact; legacy Tasks are not created or changed.
